pairs.subject: generative-provider-routing
pairs.evidence: lib/imaging/router.ts:93 The dev generate plan puts agy first even though agy is unpriced and was only checked to work live, ahead of Google, which won the measured cost-per-usable grid, so for unreferenced requests the plan order is a belief and not a measurement.

techniques.evidence: lib/imaging/router.ts:93 The chokepoint, per-env table and steer rules hold (orderFor avoid throws noAlternative, prefer reorders only), but a new vendor entered AHEAD of the measured incumbent instead of behind it.

lib/imaging/router.ts:87 The plan-top position rests on a live check and not on a usable-output grid. The pre-call gate itself conforms: reserve(estimatePendingUsd(pendingImages)) runs once per request at router.ts:312, and a batch is priced as N.

lib/imaging/router.ts:405 Unsupported, constraint, no-key and called-and-failed each land in the trail. The trail goes on provenance, into the error (with the constraint outranking the vendor error) and into logCall.
lib/imaging/errors.ts:112 Refusal, rate-limit and no-key walk the chain, while over-budget and invalid throw. The Google adapter reads an empty success as a safety block.

lib/imaging/pricing.ts:12 Every price row carries a source and a checked date and may be deliberately unpriced (agy, Lite, recognize). atSize binds a rate to its size, and the three-way CostBasis is carried to settle.
lib/imaging/budget.ts:105 A floor band with an underFloor report exists, and router.ts:181 unreachedPlanTops records plan-top reachability per capability.

lib/imaging/types.ts:33 Aspect is pinned on every call, but GenerateRequest has no per-stage size field. Size is one pixel table per aspect plus one process-wide GOOGLE_IMAGE_SIZE knob, so filmstrip drafts (count>1) render at the final rate and no promotion step exists.

pairs.subject: generative-provider-routing
pairs.evidence: lib/text/spend.ts:5 Text spend is count-only by the operator's 2026-10-07 ruling, so the metered Google fallback can spend with no pre-call ceiling, which the standard calls a report, not a control.

techniques.evidence: lib/text/spend.ts:5 No code under lib/text calls reserve(), so turns are booked after the call and never gated before it.
lib/text/router.ts:296 There is one PLAN table per posture (router.ts:95). Avoid removes and fails with no-alternative, and prefer only reorders when the provider is configured.
lib/text/router.ts:466 The trail rides on the result's provenance, goes into the thrown error (router.ts:491) and into logTurn.
lib/text/errors.ts:113 refused is a reroutable kind. google.ts:402 treats an empty answer with a green status as a failure, not as an empty success.
lib/text/pricing.ts:4 Rows carry a source and a checked date, and metered rows in service are unpriced on the wire, never shown as $0.

pairs.subject: generative-provider-routing
pairs.evidence: packages/kernel/src/spend/core.ts:44 The kernel's SpendClass and SpendStats carry only a ceiling and a remaining amount, with no floor or band (a grep of packages/kernel/src finds floor only in calibration), so the rebuilt spend authority looks only upward and cannot report a thrifty run.

techniques.evidence: packages/kernel/src/spend/core.ts:44 v1's floorOf/underFloor (lib/spend, used in lib/imaging/budget.ts) was not carried into the kernel class or into stats().
packages/kernel/src/spend/core.ts:96 The admit check counts held and lapsed holds before any vendor runs, and the refusal sentence says nothing was spent.
packages/kernel/src/pricing/table.ts:11 A zod row schema requires source and checked. atSize and validUntil make a mismatched quote unpriced, and quote.ts keeps the three bases apart.

pairs.subject: generative-provider-routing
pairs.evidence: packages/kernel/src/router/tables.ts:142 The kernel table copied v1's plan faithfully, including agy at the top of dev generate with no usable-output measurement, so the rebuilt router acts on an unmeasured plan order.

techniques.evidence: packages/kernel/src/router/tables.ts:142 A new vendor sits ahead of the measured incumbent. The per-posture plans are otherwise data in one table.
packages/kernel/src/router/tables.ts:10 The comment beside the order cites the Google/Leonardo grid as the reason, but that grid never measured agy.
packages/kernel/src/router/route.ts:168 Unsupported, constraint, no-key and steered-out each become an Elimination with a plain-language detail.
packages/kernel/src/router/route.ts:58 Reroutability is decided once, by kind, at the routing layer.

pairs.subject: generative-provider-routing
pairs.evidence: lib/foundry/extract/store.ts:292 The live IO keeps only provider, model, cost and basis from the router's provenance and drops reroutedFrom (a grep of lib/foundry/extract finds no reroute field), so a replica or transfer served by a fallback vendor leaves no record on the manifest of why the first choice dropped out.

techniques.evidence: lib/foundry/extract/store.ts:292 The asset's own record loses the trail, which is the unexplained fallback.
lib/foundry/extract/store.ts:291 Calls go through the chokepoint by capability. The run's generator option is passed only as a prefer steer.

lib/foundry/extract/perform.ts:33 A run ceiling is checked against the unit's pre-call estimate before the unit starts. The imaging period ceiling also applies, and an unpriced call books its estimate rather than zero.
lib/foundry/extract/engine.ts:47 Cost basis travels from provenance into the manifest's spend. An unpriced call is counted, not read as free.
